title: Spectral Measure and Tail Process for Multivariate Dynamical Extremes
summary: We study the asymptotic behavior of extreme events in multivariate stationary sequences, with particular emphasis on stochastic processes generated by dynamical systems. We develop a general framework for describing the dependence structure of extremes through two complementary objects: the tail process and the spectral measure.
